Definition: preservation of life; hence, sustenance; also the live flesh, i.e. the quick
BiblicalUsage: 1) preservation of life, sustenance; 1a) preservation of life; 1b) sustenance; 1c) reviving; 1d) the quick of the flesh, live flesh, tender or raw flesh
